mo_ta_cong_viec:
About TeenCare AI
TeenCare is building the Parenting AI for modern families — combining 1:1 mentoring for teens with AI-powered insights for parents.
We work with thousands of families weekly, turning real conversations into structured intelligence that helps parents make better decisions.
We’re a fast-growing company in Southeast Asia, backed by global investors (including Acumen, Advocates for Youth, EMpower, MIT Solve, and TiE Singapore) and trusted by parents across the region. Our products are used by families every week, and we’re building toward a platform that can scale globally. 
We operate in a high-speed, execution-driven environment — and are looking for a Project Manager to ensure teams deliver consistently and on time.
The Role
You will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Growth to ensure that priorities are executed with clarity, speed, and accountability.
This is not a coordination role — this is a delivery role.
Your job is to make sure things get done.
What You’ll Do
1. Drive Execution Across Teams
Track all key initiatives and ensure progress stays on track
Identify delays, blockers, and risks early
Push teams to meet deadlines and commitments
2. Enforce Clarity & Accountability
Ensure every task has:
clear owner
clear deadline
clear expected outcome
Follow up until completion — no silent drops
3. Remove Blockers Fast
Surface issues across teams (Product, Engineering, CS, Ops)
Coordinate resolution quickly
Escalate when needed
4. Maintain Execution Rhythm
Run weekly execution check-ins
Maintain visibility on progress across all key projects
Ensure priorities are aligned with company goals
5. Support Structured Delivery
Break down large initiatives into actionable steps
Help teams stay focused on high-impact work
Keep execution simple and fast (no unnecessary process)
